recognize_zh: 這個視野主要是成熟中的顆粒球與右上方一個核深染、成團偏位的大細胞，胞質空泡在此圖中並不明顯；單看這張無法確認 VEXAS 的前驅細胞空泡化，需搭配同病例其他視野與 UBA1 檢測。
features: Cellular aspirate dominated by maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented forms)
Large cell at upper right with abundant pale pink cytoplasm and several dense, clumped, eccentric nuclear lobes (possible hypolobated/dysplastic megakaryocyte)
Large cell at left with abundant finely granular pink cytoplasm and a small eccentric nucleus
Cytoplasmic vacuoles in precursors are sparse and inconspicuous in this field
Scattered orthochromatic normoblast and platelet-rich background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows a cellular specimen with orderly-appearing granulocytic maturation. A large cell with dense, clumped, eccentric nuclear lobes and pale cytoplasm is present, possibly representing a dysplastic megakaryocyte, and another large cell with abundant granular cytoplasm is seen at left. Distinct cytoplasmic vacuolization of myeloid or erythroid precursors, the hallmark finding of VEXAS syndrome, is not convincingly demonstrated in this particular field. Blasts are not increased in this view. The image is only partially supportive of VEXAS syndrome and should be interpreted together with other fields and UBA1 mutation testing.

ddx.vs: MDS is defined by ≥10% dysplasia in a lineage with clonal abnormalities and blast enumeration, whereas VEXAS is defined by somatic UBA1 mutation with inflammatory features.
Reactive marrows lack dysplastic megakaryocytes and precursor vacuolization and show toxic granulation with an obvious infectious or inflammatory cause.
Copper deficiency shows vacuolated precursors and ring sideroblasts with low serum copper and no UBA1 mutation.
